title: Milo's Cafe: a neighborhood site with a live patio
summaryLead: A one-page site that shows the menu, whether they're open and whether to sit outside.
story: Milo's is a European-style café in Morrisville, NC, known for focaccia sandwiches, Lavazza espresso and crepes. Before heading out, people want three things: the menu, the hours, and whether the patio is worth it today. They asked for a site that answers all three without digging. We made it one page, with a searchable menu, a patio scene that reads the weather, and links straight to online ordering.
goals: Show the menu without a PDF.
Say at a glance whether the café is open.
Help people decide if the patio is worth it today.

features.title: One page, two actions
features.text: Order buttons go to their SpotOn page, and a sticky bar keeps Order and Call within reach.

features.title: Live patio scene
features.text: An illustrated patio that follows the time of day and the weather, with a slider for the day.
features.alt: Milo's patio scene at golden hour
features.story: A photo can't tell you if today is a patio day. The scene reads current conditions for Morrisville and gives a one-line verdict. If the weather service is down, it shows the day's hours instead.

features.title: Searchable menu
features.text: All 69 items are searchable, with a meat-free filter and a star on guest favorites.
features.alt: Milo's menu with Food and Drinks tabs
features.story: Menus often sit in a PDF nobody can search. Here every item is its own entry, so adding a seasonal drink takes one line.

features.title: Pair it
features.text: Pick a food mood and a drink mood and it suggests a pairing.
features.story: First-timers face a long menu and don't know where to start. Pair it picks from lists we chose by hand. No account, no tracking.

features.title: Guest reviews
features.text: The rating and a few guest quotes in one block.

features.title: On a phone
features.text: The hero, patio and menu on a phone.
